purpose: Static design review; user selected A, with a notification inbox icon

prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium high-fidelity STATIC DESIGN REVIEW BOARD for NotifyLog, an existing Android offline notification archive app. This is concept A, title exactly "A · 清透收件箱", subtitle "NotifyLog". Reference Apple Mail and Notes editorial hierarchy and Apple's official Liquid Glass principles, but create original Android app UI, not a copied Apple product. Wide landscape image ideally 3200x2000, impeccable professional product designer presentation on pale cool gray. At top left show two large original app icons side-by-side, light and dark variations: a clear blue softly rounded glass squircle containing an elegant white outlined notification bell combined with two subtle horizontal log strokes. Top right title. Below, FOUR large front-on equal-height mobile app screen panels in one horizontal row with slim rounded borders, no physical phones, no perspective, no notch or Dynamic Island. Screen labels outside: "亮色 · 通知", "暗色 · 通知", "亮色 · 设置", "暗色 · 导出". Screens fill most of image, readable crisp simplified Chinese. Each is tall ~9:19.5. Direction: extremely restrained, airy white / almost-black graphite, precise blue accent #1677FF, strong text contrast, glass confined to floating chrome, NOT glass behind every paragraph. Convex translucent edge highlights, subtle refraction, credible frosted shadows and background blur. Main screens have tiny Android statusbar time 9:41; large title "通知", small green status dot and "记录中", discreet circular settings icon top right. A floating slim clear glass capsule filter "全部  微信  邮件  日历" near title. A beautiful continuous flat notification list organized by "今天" and "昨天", hairline separators, small colored simple app glyphs, app label, bold notification title, one-line preview, small right aligned time. Show exactly realistic synthetic samples: 微信 / 林间 / 周末去看展吗？ / 09:38; 邮件 / 设计周报 / 本周灵感已送达 / 09:24; 日历 / 产品评审 / 10:30 开始 / 09:10; 音乐 / 每日推荐 / 为你准备的新歌 / 08:56; 快递 / 包裹已送达 / 请前往驿站领取 / 昨天. Nice vertical rhythm, no unread badges since app only archives. Bottom floating liquid-glass rounded toolbar contains large search icon plus "搜索通知", then separate round export icon, one-hand reachable. Dark main is genuinely dark with equivalent hierarchy, no low-contrast gray text. Settings screen white title "设置", green compact capture status, grouped white rows "通知权限 已开启", "后台保活", "排除应用 3", "外观 跟随系统", "存储 12.8 MB", "导出日志"; modest switches only where appropriate, no paragraphs. Dark export screen shows dark main behind a beautifully frosted modal lower sheet, title "导出", concise controls "格式" segmented "CSV JSON", "范围 今天 最近7天 全部", "应用 全部应用", prominent blue pill "导出". Icon and screens must be coherent, elegant, usable, implementable, minimal. No charts, analytics dashboards, AI summary, cloud sync, marketing paragraphs, Apple logo, gratuitous huge gradients, glitter, extra phone frames. Keep all content aligned, enough internal screen margins, never clipped.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium high-fidelity STATIC DESIGN REVIEW BOARD for NotifyLog Android offline notification logger. Concept B title exactly "B · 时间长廊", subtitle "NotifyLog". This MUST be a distinctive time-focused design, inspired by restraint and chronology of Apple Calendar / Journal and Liquid Glass material, not generic inbox rows. Wide landscape image ideally 3200x2000, elegant warm ivory presentation background. Header contains original light/dark icon pair: translucent lavender squircle with TWO offset glass notification sheets and a small luminous violet recording dot, simple and recognizable at small size; no bell, no Apple logo. FOUR equal-height front-on tall mobile app screen panels in one row, labels "亮色 · 时间线", "暗色 · 时间线", "亮色 · 设置", "暗色 · 导出", fine device-independent rounded outlines, no physical iPhone frames, no notch, no perspective. Main interface uses warm pearl / deep plum-charcoal surfaces, subtle violet accent #7964E8, very refined airy typography, readable Chinese, quiet glass chrome with refractive rims and blurring only on floating navigation. Small Android statusbar 9:41. Main heading "今天" with modest date "11月12日 周四" and small green status indicator "记录中"; calendar icon top right. Below a 7-day compact pill-shaped floating glass date rail with weekday letters or Chinese weekdays, dates "9 10 11 12 13 14 15", selected 12 violet. BODY IS A CHRONOLOGICAL TIMELINE: slim vertical hairline with restrained tiny dots; times in a narrow left column, content to right, generous negative space. Three time groups "09:38", "09:24", "09:10" and below "08:56"; each group has small app glyph and app label, then medium-weight title and one short preview, NO individual frosted cards. Exact synthetic entries 微信 / 林间 / 周末去看展吗？ ; 邮件 / 设计周报 / 本周灵感已送达 ; 日历 / 产品评审 / 10:30 开始 ; 音乐 / 每日推荐 / 为你准备的新歌. Bottom very elegant floating glass dock with three actions timeline icon "时间线", magnifier "搜索", sliders "设置". Small separate round export action adjoining dock. No invented health graphs, counters, AI features. Dark timeline uses very dark plum background and vivid white type, quiet violet rail, minimal ambient tint only. Settings variant has title "设置", understated compact rows, "通知权限 已开启", "后台保活", "排除应用 3", "外观 跟随系统", "存储 12.8 MB", no explanatory paragraphs. Dark export variation has rich glass lower sheet over dim timeline with title "导出", date range "11月6日 — 11月12日", format segmented "CSV JSON", "全部应用", violet primary button "导出". At top icon pair reflects light vs dark materials. Editorial quietness, restrained translucency, smooth large radii, accurate content spacing, substantial readable type. Four panels show plausible actual app screens with no clipping. Board text only title, subtitle and screen labels. No English slogans, decorative huge spheres or illustrations.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high-end STATIC DESIGN REVIEW BOARD for NotifyLog, an Android app that records notifications offline. Concept C, title exactly "C · 静谧归档", subtitle "NotifyLog". Different architecture from an inbox and from a timeline: app-grouped archive, inspired by Apple Files and Reminders clarity with tasteful Liquid Glass floating controls. Wide landscape composition ideally 3200x2000, pale stone background. Header: original light and dark icon variants next to each other, minimal jade glass squircle containing a luminous translucent archive tray holding two floating horizontal message slips, no bell and no Apple logo. FOUR large, same-height vertical front-on phone SCREEN PANELS side by side; no actual hardware, no notch, no perspective. Caption labels "亮色 · 归档", "暗色 · 归档", "亮色 · 设置", "暗色 · 导出". Elegant soft ivory white and deep ink-green black modes, emerald/jade accent #19856F. Original premium minimalism with warm typography and excellent contrast. Glass treatments only at floating controls: polished refractive edges, gentle optical thickness, translucent blurred shadows; content groups opaque and very readable, no visual clutter. Tiny Android statusbar at top 9:41. Home heading "归档", small green dot "记录中", discrete gear icon. Under heading one concise floating glass search bar "搜索通知" with filter icon. A slim segmented control "全部 / 按应用" selected "按应用". MAIN CONTENT is vertically stacked rounded ORGANIZATION GROUPS, each white or dark elevated solid card containing multiple compact notification rows: first group 微信 with small green chat glyph, subtle count "12", chevron, two messages 林间 / 周末去看展吗？ / 09:38 and 读书小组 / 周五一起读书 / 08:42; second group 邮件 count "5", blue envelope glyph, 设计周报 / 本周灵感已送达 / 09:24; third group 日历 count "2", coral calendar glyph, 产品评审 / 10:30 开始 / 09:10. Count is stored notifications, not unread count. Quiet dividers within groups, spacious margins between groups. Bottom single wide floating crystal toolbar with archive glyph "归档" selected and clock glyph "时间", plus distinct circular export action on right. Settings screen bright: title "设置", small grouped rows "通知权限 已开启", "后台保活", "排除应用 3", "外观 跟随系统", "存储 12.8 MB", "导出日志". Dark export screen: frosted modal lower sheet over grouped archive, title "导出", short selection rows "格式 CSV", "时间 最近7天", "应用 全部应用", pale jade prominent pill "导出". Show full coherent pages and both icon modes. Use tasteful compact app glyphs; no large decorative art, no gradients across content, no dense instructional prose, no graphs or fake AI/cloud features. Chinese text should be precise, highly readable, all screen margins and bottom safe areas correct. The result must look like a polished design team's original proposal for a minimalist daily-use utility, not a generic glass dashboard.
